title: Official public agency enquiry route observations
method: Read official public website pages through web retrieval and limited static HTTP inspection. No form was submitted, no appointment was booked, no person contacted, and no live LinkedIn page was used.

pages.observed: Homepage CTA Book a Strategy Call; founder LinkedIn services, case-study links, and published plan prices in the page text.
Thirty-minute call description, pre-call profile review, discussion topics, and external Calendly booking link. Scheduler field labels were not verifiable.

records.destination: https://windmillgrowth.com/book-a-call; the page then links to Calendly

fields.basis: No enquiry form fields visible in reviewed page text; external Calendly fields not inspected.

records.claims_status: Vendor-published prices, services, and outcomes; not independently verified.

pages.observed: Homepage CTA Work with us.

Thirty-minute intro call via Calendly embed; alternate Typeform waitlist link. CTA says the call introduces the company and its content-engine playbook. Billing FAQ contains placeholder text for several answers; a 30-day free trial is claimed.
Five-part public playbook: brand foundation; strategic playbook; content engine; community management; ad amplification.
Public case-study index and vendor-presented outcome claims.
External waitlist destination. Public page extraction did not expose form fields. Observed href carried tracking placeholders source=xxxxx and offer=xxxxx.

Public results page. Figures are vendor-presented results.

limits: This is a dated public-page observation, not a persistent statement about later site state.
No form field, live appointment slot, or downstream scheduler content is claimed unless noted above.
Agency performance, case-study outcomes, service delivery, privacy practices, and contract terms were not independently audited.
The guide recommends transparent research contact only when the researcher chooses to proceed; no outreach occurred during this work.
